the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.name: Owen Harker
the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.text: The faint-guide method is how we have used plotters in the print studio for years, just without the model. Good to see the hand keep the last word.

replies.name: Mara Okonkwo-Lind
replies.text: Teodor said the same thing. The plotter came first; the model only changed what it draws. Thanks, Owen.

the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.name: Dr. Hanna Lew
the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.text: This overlaps with our authorship study: the galleries asking for process notes are doing exactly what our participants rewarded. I would love to read some of the notes themselves.

the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.name: Camille Duret
the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.text: I saw two of Vos's pieces in Rotterdam. You would never guess a model was involved, which I think is the point.

the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.name: Jules Martin
the-hand-still-leads-inside-the-studios-.text: Could a student try the sketchbook-model approach without a dedicated GPU? Asking for a final-year project.
